label: Watch Energy Bridge
info:
Bridges the esp32c6-watch <- HA home-energy sensors over MQTT (read-only).
Watch subscribes: watch/energy/state (retained, compact JSON)
  {"battery_pct":pct, "solar_w":W, "grid_w":W(signed +import/-export), "charging":bool}
Availability (LWT): watch/energy/avail = online|offline (retained).
Edit the ROLES map in 'route+build energy state' AND the entity list in
'energy sensors changed' to your HA entity_ids. See ha-bridge/README.md.

name: Home Assistant
comment: PLACEHOLDER — on import, open the HA state node and re-select your existing Home Assistant server config.

name: route + build energy state
